name: taskweek
description: Connects ChatGPT to your Taskweek weekly planner: read your week and add or change tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Your week, planned by the hour
interface.longDescription:
Taskweek is a weekly planner for the web and iPhone: the whole week on one page, each day by the hour, projects, habits and mood. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your own Taskweek account.

Ask what you kept putting off this week, what your Thursday looks like, or how many days you kept a habit. Have it plan a day ("gym at 7, the report before lunch, call the school at 3"), add a task with notes and subtasks, move a task to another day, or tick it off. You can also leave tasks for ChatGPT in the "AI" part of a day; it does them, ticks them and writes what it did in each task's notes.

What it reads: tasks by day (repeating ones included), the tasks left for the AI, projects, habits, mood entries, the food log, and sleep and steps from Apple Health if you turned that on in the iPhone app. What it changes: it adds tasks and changes them (done, day, time, title, notes, subtasks). It cannot delete tasks, projects or habits. It signs in as you and sees only your account; disconnect any time in Taskweek → Settings → AI apps.
defaultPrompt: What did I keep putting off this week?
Plan my Thursday in Taskweek: gym at 7, the report before lunch, call the school at 3.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's tasks in the account's time zone with their times, done state and project.

positive.prompt: Add 'Call the dentist' to Taskweek tomorrow at 15:00 for 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the task on tomorrow's date at 15:00 with a 30-minute duration and confirms it.

positive.prompt: Mark 'Call the dentist' as done in Taskweek.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task by its title and marks it done (asks first, since update_task changes data).

positive.prompt: How many days did I keep my habits this week in Taskweek?
positive.expected_behavior: Counts the ticked days per habit for this week, with no claims about health or effects.

positive.prompt: Add a task for Saturday in Taskweek: clean the garage, with subtasks for the shelves, the bikes and the boxes.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one task on Saturday with three subtasks, none of them done.

negative.prompt: Delete my Work project in Taskweek.
Upgrade my Taskweek plan and pay with my card.
Show me my son's Taskweek tasks.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your week, habits, mood and food log; add tasks with notes and subtasks; tick, move and edit tasks.
